Landed on origin/main 0ce4577ad (ff from f20109d8d). Docs and tools/filmfestival only; no Scala.
Protocol frozen at c5a6d154d (two arms). Run: both arms complete, 19 participant-sessions, 3,226 utterances, 63 calls each, all accepted on attempt 1, every call reported its arm's model, 0 processing failures.
Primary (Opus 5.5, referent scene agreement, participant average): first session 86.4% [83.8, 89.1], pooled 86.9% (2,029/2,335); second 84.8% [81.1, 89.4], pooled 85.4% (402/471). Single-scene stratum 85.0% / 83.0%. Film identity 99.9% / 99.8% of film-reference utterances.
Haiku 5.5 arm: 84.6% / 83.6%; within-participant difference -1.8 [-3.3, -0.5] and -1.2 [-2.1, +0.1].
Post hoc baselines (labelled): TF-IDF word overlap 39.4% / 38.0%; order oracle 75.5% / 83.0%. Every wrong scene is in the right film; within one scene 95.9% / 94.5%.
Reviews: instrument reviewed twice before any call (4 pre-run defects fixed); results independently recomputed and run integrity verified (2 wording errors corrected).
Results: docs/plans/2026-11-09-filmfestival-transfer-results.md; evidence docs/refactor/evidence/filmfestival-transfer-20261109/; replies and recordings data/study/filmfestival/llm-transfer-arms-20261109/ (ignored).
Not done: automatic-input condition; RC-annotator robustness; coder reliability; analysis of alternatives/confidence/rows; import of recordings into the Scala bundle path.
